name: What are the signs of poor weatherproofing on a sliding patio door?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of poor weatherproofing on a sliding patio door?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs of poor weatherproofing include drafts coming from around the door frame or glass, visible gaps when the door is closed, and water leaks during rain. You might also notice condensation between double-pane glass, which indicates a failed seal. Increased dust inside your home near the door, higher than usual heating or cooling bills, and the presence of insects or pests entering through the gaps are also common indicators. Feeling cold spots near the door during winter or warm spots during summer can also signal inadequate sealing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include drafts, visible gaps, water leaks, condensation between glass, increased dust, higher energy bills, and pests.
